Assert that two manifests describe the same quantities the same way

Source: R/obs_schema.R
assert_obs_schema_correspondence.Rd

Compares the observation schemas of two manifests and refuses the pairing when a column they share by name disagrees on its quantity or its unit.

Usage

assert_obs_schema_correspondence(m1, m2, what = c("outputs", "params"))

Arguments

m1

The first manifest.

m2

The second manifest.

what

Which schema sides to compare. Any subset of "outputs" and "params"; both by default.

Value

NULL, invisibly, when the schemas agree or when either side carries no schema. Errors on a disagreement.

Details

The check is opt-in by presence. When either manifest lacks an obs_schema it is a graceful no-op, so the guard activates only once both emitters populate the field and no existing pipeline breaks on the day the guard lands. Columns present in only one schema are ignored; only the shared names are compared, and only on the fields that carry meaning for that side – quantity and unit for outputs, unit for params.

Refusing rather than warning is the deliberate choice. A unit mismatch between two manifests is not a degraded comparison, it is an incommensurable one, and any number produced from it is wrong by a factor nobody downstream can recover.

See also

orchestra_manifest for the obs_schema property.

Author

Max Moldovan

Examples

schema_of <- function(unit) {
  list(outputs = data.frame(name = c("o1", "o2"),
                            quantity = c("grain_yield", "grain_yield"),
                            unit = c(unit, "t/ha")))
}
build <- function(unit) {
  orchestra_manifest(
    emitter_package = "example",
    emitter_version = "0.1.0",
    inferential_target = "predictions",
    run_id = paste0("example-", unit),
    method = "example:demo",
    obs_schema = schema_of(unit),
    timestamp = Sys.time(),
    data_hash = manifest_data_hash(data.frame(), NULL, NULL, NULL,
                                   NA_integer_)
  )
}
assert_obs_schema_correspondence(build("t/ha"), build("t/ha"))
try(assert_obs_schema_correspondence(build("t/ha"), build("kg/ha")))
#> Error : obs_schema correspondence FAILED: outputs column 'o1' disagrees on unit ('t/ha' vs 'kg/ha') -- refusing to compare incommensurable quantities across manifests
